Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1- This Limited tender enquiry bid is restricted for vendors who are established for su bject item “DIAPHRAGM FOR 84MM HEAT-751 & HEAT-551’ ’and also registered with any factory/Unit under MIL/erstwhile OFB for the subject item. If any firm/firms partici pate in the bid & give certificate that the firm is established (with MIL group of factori es/erstwhile OFB) before bid opening and registered with (any factory/Unit under MIL/ erstwhile OFB) for the subject item as mentioned above then offer of that firm/firms may be considered for technical evaluation, rest firms shall be rejected during techni cal evaluation. Established suppliers also have to get themselves registered f or the tendered item as mentioned above if their registration has expired. 2- Offer of those bidders who are not established and registered source of the subject item/ similar item as mentioned above under procurement at OFK shall be rejected/ignored. 3- Inspection to be carried out as per inspection document i.e. QAP, Specification/Drawing a s part of TE. Inspection authority is CGM/OFK or his authorized representative & place of ins pection is OFK premises. 4- Bidders have to either submit Registration Certificate for same item/similar item as ment ioned above with any factory/Unit under MIL/erstwhile OFB OR submit duly filled vendor reg istration request form (VRRF) in case the firm is not registered or its registration has expire d. For registration purpose the firm has to submit online VRRF form including all the require d details & requisite documents for Capacity verification through vendor registration facility available at vendor.munitionsindia.in before tender opening date else its offer will not be c onsidered. Bidder while filling VRRF has to pay requisite application fee along with 18% GS T for item registration and upload payment receipt details with the Bid. In case the online link does not work then the firm has to submit duly filled & signed VRRF o ffline including all the required details & requisite documents along with the Bid else the off er of the Bidder will not be considered. Further the Bidder also has to pay requisite applicati on fee along with 18% GST for item registration through online mode only and upload the p ayment receipt along with the Bid. The format of VRRF and payment details (i.e. fees amou nt & Bank account details) is available in “Buyer uploaded ATC document” section of the Bi d Document. 5. Bidder has to submit Udyam Registration Certificate for availing Purchase preference cla use of Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs). 6. Bidder has to submit the MII document/certificate mentioning the %age of local content o

f material to be supplied. 7. Option clause: 50% OC applicable. 8. Delivery Period shall include supply of full order including all the inspection process invol ving raw material inspection, stage/final inspection before bulk supply as per drawing and s pecification. 9. Payment Terms- 100% payment within 30 days from the date of acceptance of material at OFK premises. 10. Compliance statement is enclosed herewith. Bidder has to submit this compliance state ment completely filled & duly signed with seal of the firm. 11. If any firm is found as debarred for the subject item at any stage before placing of supp ly order, bid of that firm will not be considered for further evaluation. 12. MODEL ECS MANDATE FORMAT (ANNEXURE-18) is uploaded along with complianc e statement. Firm must submit ANNEXURE-18 and certify that Bank Details submitted is co rrect and complete. The firm must submit this document every time along with the material supply. 13. NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uploaded with bid: (i). I M/s. ....... hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, specific ation, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and aft er expiry of Contract. (ii). If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 14. Performance Security Deposit/EPBG in favour of “Munitions India Limited O FK hamaria” is to be submitted by the supplier within 30 days from the date of award of contract as per TE terms & conditions if contract value (including all taxes) exceeds than 5 lakhs. 15. Unloading/Loading of dispatched material will be done by Store Section/OFK’s hired lab ourers. The charges of the same will be deducted @ Rs 220/ton from the regular bills of fir m. 16. Relevant provisions of MIL STORE PURCHASE MANUAL-2023 shall also be part of Tender enquiry. NOTE: Bidders may please note that GEM is capturing & showing the IP addresses used by the Buyer and the Bidder(s)/Seller(s). The received bids having matching /common IP address with either Bidder(s)/Seller(s) or Buyer, shall be outrightly r ejected & shall not be considered for further evaluation. . 6.
